rationale: Codex is one of only two pins whose wrapper cannot be stepped around (I measured `git -C . status` returning 0 on antigravity and cursor and 2 on codex and claude), and it beats my own pin on the tie-breaker that actually fires often: codex found that my reissue path at src/runLoop.ts:1427 calls buildOrder without the materialized descriptors, so every rejected artifact — a routine event, which this very issue triggered on my own review — is re-issued with the `## Bound input files` section erased while the wrapper still refuses the git reads, whereas codex passes them at its equivalent line 1387; codex also validates packet identity and entry digests on reuse where I only check that each recorded path exists. Its remaining flaw is real and one I verified — an unreadable bound blob throws out of runTick, and `run()` has no catch, so the coordinator process dies and stops every agent — but that needs a damaged mirror to fire, where my defect needs only a normal rejection, and the fix is to carry the failure as an outstanding item the way resolveChangeScope already documents.
